Passed on the fake backend only (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level); model-authored by deepseek-v4.1-flash:1017 and unreviewed (reviewed_by null). Isaac Sim 4.2 and Isaac Lab 1.4 are external to the clone (README.md:26) and were not installed, so the fake backend is the package's own analytic kinematic stand-in (fake.py), the registered environment (omni.isaac.lab.envs:ManagerBasedRLEnv) was never run or compared with it, and the sim backend (gymnasium.make) was not run. The fake is F0: no rigid-body dynamics, contacts, actuators, sensors or noise; it never terminates or truncates; no snapshot/restore. Its 12-value action and 36-value observation are placeholders: the configured task writes one joint-position target per joint matched by joint_names ['.*'] of the external robot asset and concatenates its observation terms, so the real dimensions depend on that asset and are not stated in the clone. NOT COVERED: the real action/observation arrays, the Isaac Lab physics and randomization, and the registered environment's termination behaviour. Expected warnings: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed only sets the next reset, so it makes no native call); G7.MAYBE_ABSENT x5 for action_space, observation_space, reset, step and close (native is the card's confirmed in-tree config class AnymalDBlindFlatEnvCfg, while the Gymnasium environment class and its ManagerBasedRLEnvCfg base are external); G8.NO_UNIT x4 for the bridge-derived integer seed/ticks inputs and numeric action.values (the simulator may use its own units). No G4 warnings. Only catalogue classes are used, so there are no catalogue requests.
